name: 5 CARD STUD HIGH-LOW WITH A BUY
description: Five Card Stud High-Low with a Buy: each player gets one hole card and four face-up cards over four betting rounds. Pot split between best high hand and best low hand (typically 8-or-better). The buy is an optional mechanic allowing players to purchase an extra card or modifier; exact implementation varies by house rules.

content.text: Five Card Stud High-Low with a Buy: each player gets one hole card and four face-up cards over four betting rounds. Pot split between best high hand and best low hand (typically 8-or-better). The buy is an optional mechanic allowing players to purchase an extra card or modifier; exact implementation varies by house rules.

Stud poker first appeared in America in the 1860s as an open game with one hole card and four face-up cards. Five Card Stud High-Low with a Buy is a home and club variant that combines the high-low split pot with an optional buy round after the fifth card; it persists in home games even as casino five-card stud declined in the late 20th century.
Standard 52-card pack. Only five cards per player are dealt, so up to 10 can play.
One down, four up; four betting rounds.

items.text: Two rounds of buying: After the fifth card, play two buy rounds; the second round costs more (e.g. two large bets) than the first.
